owner_instruction: Yaptığımız bütün Görselleri Arşivle Narrative içerisinde. Hiç birini beğenmedim, farklı yere yaptırtacağım.
archive_policy: Byte-identical archive of artwork variants, all developer/UI previews, videos, original prompts/provenance and runtime image counterparts; original historical paths retained for existing references. Unpublished app-icon runtime copies removed after archiving.
game_runtime_art_until_replacements: Existing tracked bindings remain temporary rejected development placeholders; no new icon promotion, no final acceptance claim. New owner-supplied designs will replace these consumers individually.
